gate.title: Which numerology method will you work with?
gate.sub: The two methods are independent; their calculation rules and records are kept separate. You can review the two records side by side whenever you wish.

a.title: Holistic Numerology
a.sub: A holistic numerology workspace based on training techniques.
a.masterNumber: All digits are added in a single pass and the intermediate total is shown (e.g. 32/5).

b.title: Classical Numerology
b.sub: Western and Chaldean traditions; a calculation you can verify step by step.
b.letterTable: Pythagorean (Western) and Chaldean (Cheiro) — two separate methods
b.masterNumber: Month, day and year are reduced separately; 11 · 22 · 33 are preserved.
b.foot: The calculation of every number is shown step by step.

compare.title: Comparative Review
compare.lead: Review the same client's records from both methods side by side, concept by concept. Numbers are not merged; the original analyses remain unchanged.

home.title: Numerology
home.sub: Calculate your life map, create your report and save your analyses. Choose a module.

analiz.title: Numerology Analysis
analiz.desc: Full engine output from first name, surname and date of birth; tabbed analysis, a premium life-map visual and high-resolution PNG export on a single screen.

kayitli.title: Saved Analyses
kayitli.desc: List your records; open each record with its full name, date of birth and save time, and view its full-text summary instantly.

bilgi.title: Knowledge Base
bilgi.desc: Edit numerology training notes, explanations, interpretation texts and knowledge content in one centre.

home.foot: Numerology — discover yourself through the language of numbers, analyse your life map and manage your knowledge in one centre.
